name: Baxter Nerve Entrapment
definition: Entrapment of the first branch of the lateral plantar nerve, a recognized cause of chronic medial plantar heel pain.

core: Plantar fascia and tarsal tunnel screen

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical; MRI may show abductor digiti minimi denervation in chronic cases.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, cartilage, ligament or occult injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent focal entrapment may require specialist intervention.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada Vata-neuralgic phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Entrapment of the first branch of the lateral plantar nerve, a recognized cause of chronic medial plantar heel pain.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, unreduced dislocation, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
